    return make(OperationSymbol(name, arity), size, table)

or2 = _op("or", 2, 2, [0, 1, 1, 1])
id1 = _op("id", 1, 2, [0, 1])

proj = _op("proj", 2, 2, [0, 0, 1, 1])
